methodologyNotes: Covers 11 verified pressure-mount and hardware-mount walk-through baby/pet gates, sourced primarily from manufacturer sites (Regalo, Cardinal Gates, Evenflo, North States/Toddleroo, Kids2/Summer Infant, Cumbor) with retailer listings (Target, Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon, Chewy) and resale-comparison sites used for corroboration and, in a few cases, for the only obtainable US price. Independently re-verified on 2026-08-19: every product was confirmed to actually exist; six prices were corroborated directly on manufacturer product pages (Regalo Easy Step $50.99, Summer/Kids2 $109.99, Cardinal Gates SS-30 $99.95, Supergate Ergo $27.99, Toddleroo Easy Swing & Lock Series 2 $74.99, Evenflo $34.99); Regalo Extra Tall Wide Span $64.99 confirmed on Target; Regalo Retractable $39.98 confirmed via the registry price embedded in Regalo's own page. BabyDan Premier's price was corrected from the draft's $84.99 (a used-gear resale-marketplace figure) to the $119.99 published on its cited primary listing. Cumbor's only obtainable US price is a third-party reseller list price ($99.99, discounted to ~$79.98) since Cumbor's own site and Amazon do not surface a price in fetched content. Munchkin Loft has no reliable current MSRP, so its price is left null. Widths and heights are inch values/ranges with units inline; boolean specs are true/false only when a source explicitly made the claim, and null whenever no source confirmed the feature either way (null is not a claim of absence). priceUsd is a list/MSRP price at time of check, not a live sale price. accessedAt 2026-08-19. No products were removed.

products.name: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Safety Gate
products.priceNote: MSRP, standard 29-38.5 in size, official Regalo store
products.provenance: Re-verified on Regalo's official product page: 29-38.5 in width range (6 in extension included), 30 in height, all-metal frame, 16 in walk-through door, one-hand operation, and $50.99 price. Page describes it as a pressure-mount design with wall cups for securing; recorded mount_type 'both' because the wall cups screw into the wall for optional hardware anchoring, though pressure is the primary mount.

products.name: Summer Infant Multi-Use Decorative Extra Tall Walk-Thru Pet and Baby Gate
products.priceNote: MSRP, Beige colorway, official Kids2/Summer Infant store
products.provenance: Re-verified on Kids2's official listing: 29-48 in width, 36 in height (incl. arch), 97% metal / 3% plastic, no-drill pressure mount with a hardware kit included for stairs (mount_type 'both'), 19 in auto-closing walk-through door, and $109.99 price. Home Depot corroborates the 29-48 in / 36 in dimensions for the same SKU family (model 07060).

products.name: Cardinal Gates Stairway Special Safety Gate (SS-30)
products.priceNote: MSRP, aluminum version, official Cardinal Gates store
products.provenance: Re-verified on Cardinal Gates' own page: aluminum SS-30 fits 27-42.5 in (wood version 29-49.5 in), 29.5 in tall, wall-mounted (hardware only), one-hand adult latch, two-way swinging door, and $99.95 price. Note: the Lowe's corroboration URL is actually Cardinal Gates' 'Stairs and More' model, a different product, so it is retained only as a brand cross-reference; the SS-30 numbers rest on the authoritative manufacturer page.

products.name: Munchkin Loft Aluminum Hardware Mounted Baby Gate
products.priceNote: No reliable current MSRP found; observed retailer prices ranged widely ($89-$130+) with inconsistent 'was' pricing, so left unset rather than guessed
products.provenance: Amazon listing confirms the Munchkin Loft Hardware Mounted Baby Gate: 26.5-40 in width, silver aluminum, hardware mount, one-hand handle. Lowe's listing (40 in x 30.5 in) corroborates the 30.5 in height and 40 in max width. No current Munchkin.com SKU and no two retailers agreed on a price, so priceUsd and auto_close are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Evenflo Position & Lock Tall & Wide Baby Gate

specs.material: Wood frame with coated wire mesh

products.provenance: Re-verified on Evenflo's own spec sheet: tension (pressure) mount, 31-50 in opening, 31 in height, wood frame with coated wire mesh, $34.99. Evenflo describes a static lift-and-lock barrier, not a hinged door, so walk_through_door is false; one-hand operation and auto-close are not claimed on the page, so left null.

products.name: Toddleroo by North States Supergate Ergo
products.priceNote: MSRP, Ivory colorway, official North States store
products.provenance: Re-verified on the Toddleroo by North States product page: 26-42 in width, 26 in height, dual hardware/pressure mount (mount_type 'both'), plastic, one-hand press-and-release latch, and $27.99 price. Amazon corroborates the 26-42 in / 26 in dimensions.

products.name: Regalo Extra Tall Wide Span Walk-Thru Gate
products.priceNote: Typical retail price, Target listing, black finish, 37 in tall
products.provenance: Re-verified on Target's listing: 29-49 in width (extensions included), 37 in height, hardware/pressure dual mount (mount_type 'both'), all-steel construction, 16 in walk-through door, and $64.99 price. Chewy's 'Widespan Extra Tall Walk-Through Gate, 37-in' listing corroborates the height. Treated as a legacy-but-still-sold SKU.

products.name: Toddleroo by North States Easy Swing & Lock Gate Series 2
products.priceNote: MSRP, matte bronze finish, official North States store
products.provenance: Re-verified on North States' own page: 28.68-47.85 in width, 31 in height, hardware-only mount, steel with matte bronze finish, one-hand latch, and $74.99 price. The page's FAQ explicitly states the gate has no auto-close and must be closed manually (auto_close false). Amazon corroborates the width/height/finish.

products.name: Cumbor Auto Close Baby Gate for Stairs (29.7-46 in)
products.priceNote: Reseller list price ($99.99, discounted to ~$79.98); Cumbor's own site/Amazon do not surface a price in fetched content. Gray colorway
products.provenance: Re-verified on Cumbor's own brand page: 29.7-46 in width, 30.5 in height, pressure mount also drill/hardware compatible (mount_type 'both'), walk-through, auto-close. Cumbor's site and Amazon did not surface a price, so the $99.99 list price is taken from a third-party reseller (which shows $99.99 list -> $79.98 sale) and flagged as reseller-derived rather than a manufacturer MSRP. Material 'Steel' reflects the product line's established metal construction; not explicitly restated on the fetched primary page.

products.name: Regalo Retractable Baby Gate
products.priceNote: Model #1850 G, price confirmed via the registry price embedded in Regalo's official product page

specs.material: PVC mesh with plastic mounting frame

products.provenance: Re-verified on Regalo's official product page: model #1850 G, hardware-mounted retractable PVC-mesh barrier expanding up to 50 in wide, 30 in tall, plastic mounting system.
